title: RoboParty Unveils RP1, a High-Performance Full-Stack Open-Source Humanoid Robot at IROS
source_used: RoboParty press release via PR Newswire (carried by Kyodo)
key_facts: RoboParty unveiled RP1 (ROBOTO 01) at IROS 2026 in Pittsburgh on 28 Sep
Described by the company as the first high-performance full-stack open-source bipedal humanoid
At a booth demo visitors pushed and kicked the robot and it recovered its balance
Peak joint torque up to 160 N-m; runs on PartyOS with an unsupervised reinforcement-learning training framework called UFO
Roadmap to be announced in Oct 2026, with a mass-production programme later in Q4
quote_evidence: RoboParty positions RP1 as the world's first high-performance full-stack open-source bipedal humanoid robot.
RP1 rapidly adjusted its posture and recovered its balance under these external disturbances
why_it_matters_hint: An open-source humanoid aimed at researchers and developers, with company claims only.
notes: This is a PR Newswire press release (issuer text); 'world's first' is a company claim. Event from 28 Sep. Score cut 1.
